source_audit: Terence Tao, Product set estimates for non-commutative groups, arXiv:math/0601431v3, https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0601431v3. This turn implements the continuous Ruzsa specialization and the trace/popular-overlap argument of Lemma4.3 and Proposition4.5. All n sandwich powers were proved by a short convolution induction rather than separate n=1,n=3 proofs. The resulting constants match the displayed Proposition4.5 inequality; composition with the earlier deliberately relaxed self-energy BSG gives K=2^55 L^21. These are supporting formalizations of known arguments, not new impossibility results. For the next step, Lemma3.6, Definition3.8 and Theorem3.10 were read R1798: the finite symmetric covering set must be contained in H^2. Plan H=T^3, using the proved n=7 sandwich bound and finite packing; do not substitute a weaker definition silently.

For open A subset Box(Q), H(A)>0, finite K>=1 and H(AA^-1)<=K H(A), T={x:(1_(A^-1)*1_A)(x)>H(A)/(2K)} contains1, is inversion-symmetric and open, and has compact closure in Box(2Q^2). H(A)<=2K H(T)<=4K^2 H(A); for every n>=0, H(A*T^n*A^-1)<=2^n K^(2n+1)H(A). Hence H(A*T)<=2K^3 H(A) and H(T^3)<=16K^8 H(T). A direct composition from the R1797 self-energy input constructs A subset O and this T with K=2^55 L^21, H(O)<=2^62 L^23 H(T), and H(T)<=2^56 L^21 H(O). This completes the actual symmetric-core construction, including the representation proof for every sandwich power. Finite approximate-group covering, metric transfer, SL2 growth/escape, strict flattening and unconditional paid padding remain unproved. These are supporting formalizations of known arguments, not new transposition bounds.
